lore.common: Hides its partner under the bed every morning just as you're late for school.
lore.uncommon: Walks home by itself from any field, always by the muddiest route. Then waits on the doormat looking innocent.
lore.rare: Leaves muddy footprints that keep walking after it stops. They have reached the bathroom twice and the loft once.
lore.epic: Stamped once on the school field and every puddle in town jumped out of its hole. The lollipop lady is still mopping.
lore.legendary: Walked a thousand miles home after being left at a campsite. Its first act was to kick mud on whoever forgot it.

lore.common: Spins round so wide when you twirl that it knocks the cake off the table.
lore.uncommon: Catches its hem on every door handle on the way out of the party.
lore.rare: Grows a new pocket wherever one is needed. Grandma has found forty sweets in it and a lost hamster.
lore.epic: Spun so fast at the wedding that it took off like a helicopter. The bouquet is still on the town hall roof.
lore.legendary: Spun so beautifully at the ball that the clock stopped to watch. The party got an extra hour, and still ran out of cake.

names.legendary: Woolly Wilbur of the Winter Peaks

lore.common: Itches your nose all morning, and it's the one place you can't scratch.
lore.uncommon: Leaves only your eyes showing, so nobody recognises you at the bus stop.
lore.rare: Knits a new hole wherever you need to scratch. By lunchtime it is mostly holes and its owner is mostly face.
lore.epic: Stretched over a whole village of snowmen to keep them cosy. By lunch the village was one big woolly puddle.
lore.legendary: Kept a mountain top so warm that it stopped snowing there. Skiers now queue at the summit in shorts.

lore.common: Slips down over your eyes every time you run.
lore.uncommon: Flaps round your neck in the wind like a little flag.
lore.rare: Ties itself over the face of anyone who sneezes nearby. The library now looks like a gang of very polite outlaws.
lore.epic: Flapped so hard on a windy hill that it whipped up a dust storm. The whole village now sneezes in the same direction.
lore.legendary: Lassoed a runaway cattle stampede with one corner. The cows agreed to walk home if it promised to stop flapping.

lore.common: Pulls your hair every time you take it off after swimming.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes your head so tightly that your ears pop.
lore.rare: Squeaks like a dolphin underwater. The lifeguard has closed the pool twice to look for it.
lore.epic: Stuck to the bottom of the pool so hard that it pulled the plug out. The swimming club finished the race on the grass.
lore.legendary: Swam across the sea by itself and reached the far side first. Its swimmer arrived an hour later, cold and very cross.

names.legendary: Grand Fuzzbusby of the Palace Guard

lore.common: Tickles the nose of every guard standing next to it, and none of them are allowed to sneeze.
lore.uncommon: Is so tall and furry that its owner has to duck under every doorway.
lore.rare: Growls like a real bear whenever a tourist pulls a face. The ice-cream van now parks round the corner.
lore.epic: Grew so tall overnight that the guard behind it could not see. He marched straight into the palace pond, still in step.
lore.legendary: Stood so still for so long that a family of birds moved in on top. The guards now change shifts on tiptoe.

lore.common: Slides off to one side no matter how carefully you put it on.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it think they are a great painter.
lore.rare: Paints a tiny moustache on every portrait it walks past. The art gallery has stopped letting it in.
lore.epic: Tilted so far over one ear that the whole café tilted with it. Every croissant slid off the tables and into the river.
lore.legendary: Painted a sunset so real that the actual sun went down early to compare. The whole town had dinner at four.

names.legendary: Sir Bowlerby of the Morning Train

lore.common: Rolls off your head on the windiest day and down the high street.
lore.uncommon: Goes everywhere with an umbrella, and won't be seen without one.
lore.rare: Tips itself to every single person in the street. Its owner arrives at work an hour late with a very sore neck.
lore.epic: Lifted off in a gust and every bowler in town followed like a flock of birds. The pigeons have filed a complaint.
lore.legendary: Caught the morning train without its owner and went to work alone. It now has a desk, a name badge and the window seat.

lore.common: Flops down over your eyes every time you try to look up.
lore.uncommon: Has a floppy brim all the way round so the rain drips off in every direction.
lore.rare: Holds a whole bucket of rain on its brim and tips it over whoever laughs at it. The campsite has run out of dry people.
lore.epic: Flipped over at the festival and was used as a real bucket. It carried enough mud to build a second stage.
lore.legendary: Collected so much rain at one festival that it became a pond. A family of ducks moved in and will not leave.

names.legendary: The Crown That Crowned a Cat

lore.common: Is so heavy that it slides down over your ears every time you nod.
lore.uncommon: Sparkles so brightly in the sun that everyone has to squint at you.
lore.rare: Makes whoever wears it give silly royal orders. Grandpa wore it for ten minutes and banned Tuesdays.
lore.epic: Rolled off during the parade and down the hill like a golden wheel. Half the town chased it and the parade ended at the bakery.
lore.legendary: Was put on the palace cat by mistake. The cat has now ruled for nine years and has only ever banned baths.

lore.common: Muffles every question you are asked, so you answer the wrong one all day.
lore.uncommon: Has two fluffy pom-poms that make you look like a bear.
lore.rare: Picks up the radio through its fluff. Plays the football scores into your ears during the maths test.
lore.epic: Clamped itself over the school fire alarm. The whole school had a lovely quiet fire drill that nobody knew about.
lore.legendary: Sat on top of a thundercloud and muffled the whole storm. The cloud now only rains in whispers.

lore.common: Tips forward over your eyes every time you look mysterious.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it suddenly want to solve a mystery.
lore.rare: Solves mysteries nobody asked about. Has told the whole street exactly who leaves the bin lid open.
lore.epic: Pulled its brim so low over the town that it was night by lunchtime. The owls went to work early.
lore.legendary: Solved the greatest mystery in the city: who keeps moving the garden gnomes. They had gone on holiday and sent postcards.

names.legendary: Old Topper, Hat of All Hats

lore.common: Flies off your head on every windy day and leads you on a chase down the street.
lore.uncommon: Leaves your hair squashed flat when you take it off, so you have to keep it on.
lore.rare: Swapped heads with every hat at the party when nobody was looking.
lore.epic: Pulled a rabbit out of itself at a birthday party, then another, then forty. The garden is now mostly rabbits.
lore.legendary: Blew off one windy morning and landed on every head in town in turn. By night it had been worn by four thousand people and a horse.

lore.common: Slides down over your eyes just as you're about to catch the ball.
lore.uncommon: Holds back your hair so tightly that your eyebrows look surprised.
lore.rare: Saves up a whole match of sweat and wrings it out over the umpire. The tennis club now hands out umbrellas.
lore.epic: Was stretched across the finish line at sports day and pinged the winner back to the start. He has now won twice.
lore.legendary: Kept one runner's hair out of his eyes for a whole marathon. He ran so straight that he finished in the next town.

lore.common: Its tassel swings in front of your nose and makes you sneeze.
lore.uncommon: Has a flat square top that slides off whenever you look down.
lore.rare: Was thrown in the air at graduation and landed on the head of the headmistress.
lore.epic: Was thrown so high at graduation that it landed on a passing plane. It has since graduated in four more countries.
lore.legendary: Has sat through so many speeches that it now gives them. Last year it spoke for six hours and gave itself a degree in snoring.

lore.common: Crinkles so loudly in the shower that you can't hear yourself singing.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a see-through bubble on your head, and everyone laughs.
lore.rare: Puffs up with steam until it floats off out of the window. The neighbours keep bringing it back, slightly damp.
lore.epic: Blew up so big in the hotel steam room that it covered every guest like a tent. Nobody got wet, and nobody found the door.
lore.legendary: Stayed on through a storm at sea, a waterfall and a car wash. The curls underneath have never felt a single raindrop.

lore.common: Gets damp from your breath and then freezes stiff on the ski lift.
lore.uncommon: Covers everything but your eyes, so you look like a woolly ninja.
lore.rare: Fogs up every pair of goggles it gets near. The ski instructor has taught a whole lesson to a tree.
lore.epic: Breathed out so much warm air on the slope that the snow melted into a river. The ski school finished the day in boats.
lore.legendary: Raced an avalanche down the mountain and won by a nose. The avalanche wants a rematch and is still climbing back up.

lore.common: Blows off into the sea the moment you get to the beach.
lore.uncommon: Has a brim so wide that the whole family can sit in its shade.
lore.rare: Follows the sun round the garden by itself, dragging its owner along. Grandpa has been round the house nine times today.
lore.epic: Opened its brim so wide on the beach that it shaded the whole sea. The fish asked for the sun back by teatime.
lore.legendary: Blocked the sun for a whole summer so its owner never got a freckle. The tomatoes went on strike.

lore.common: Slips out of your hair and falls into the punch bowl.
lore.uncommon: Sparkles in every photo, so nobody can see your face.
lore.rare: Makes whoever wears it wave like royalty at everything. Dad waved at the bin lorry for twenty minutes.
lore.epic: Sparkled so much at the ball that the chandelier felt jealous.
lore.legendary: Was worn by a pigeon for a whole year after a ball. The pigeon now refuses crumbs unless they come on a plate.

names.legendary: Coach Shadewell of the Tennis Club

lore.common: Has no top, so the sun burns your head while your eyes stay shaded.
lore.uncommon: Blocks the glare so well that you can watch the ball against the sun.
lore.rare: Bounces sunlight into the other player's eyes at exactly the wrong moment. The umpire has asked it to face the wall.
lore.epic: Shaded centre court so well that the grass thought it was night and went to sleep. The final was played in the car park.
lore.legendary: Has watched so many finals that it now calls the lines itself. It is never wrong, and the umpire has taken up knitting.

names.legendary: Madame Perruque of the Grand Theatre

lore.common: Slips sideways on your head during the school play.
lore.uncommon: Has curls so bouncy that they wobble when you talk.
lore.rare: Grows a new hairstyle every night. Monday a beehive, Tuesday a quiff, Wednesday something the cat tried to adopt.
lore.epic: Grew so big in the final scene that the actors got lost in its curls. The curtain came down so they could be combed out.
lore.legendary: Played every part in one night: king, queen, villain and horse. It took eleven bows and asked for a twelfth.

lore.common: Squashes your hair flat and leaves a line round your forehead.
lore.uncommon: Bonks against every door frame because you forget you're wearing it.
lore.rare: Bounces off everything twice as hard as it hits it. Its owner headed a football into the next town.
lore.epic: Bumped a doorframe so hard that the whole building site wobbled. The crane driver now wears two helmets.
lore.legendary: Took a falling piano on the head and played a perfect note. Its owner walked away humming.

lore.common: Hides your keys in a pocket you didn't even know it had.
lore.uncommon: Jams its zip at the bottom so you have to wriggle out of it like a snake.
lore.rare: Takes itself off the hook and goes to school without you. Its marks are now better than yours.
lore.epic: Turned its collar up so high that it hid the whole office. Everyone went home early because nobody could find the boss.
lore.legendary: Has an inside pocket so deep that the family moved in. Grandma has the room by the zip and complains of draughts.

lore.common: Comes out of the washing machine one size smaller every single time.
lore.uncommon: Has pockets full of fluff, old tissues and a forgotten sweet.
lore.rare: Rips at the knee whenever a teacher looks. The rip then grows a second knee, which also wants to be fashionable.
lore.epic: Turned the washing machine blue, then the bathroom, then the dog. The whole house now matches the jeans.
lore.legendary: Went so long without a wash that they now stand in the corner on their own. Last week they went to the shops alone.

lore.common: Catches in the car door every time you get out.
lore.uncommon: Dries your hands, your face and the dog, all on the same day.
lore.rare: Wraps itself round anyone who says they are cold and will not let go until spring. The postman is still wearing it.
lore.epic: Soaked up the whole paddling pool in one go, then the bath. The garden hose is now afraid of it.
lore.legendary: Wrapped the town clock tower one winter to keep it warm. The clock got so cosy it fell asleep, and nobody was late for a month.

names.legendary: Professor Robesworth of the Old Hall

lore.common: Flaps its huge sleeves whenever its owner talks, and the pigeons outside flap back.
lore.uncommon: Is so long that it sweeps the floor of every corridor it walks down.
lore.rare: Billowed out so dramatically on the stage that the professor nearly floated away.
lore.epic: Spread its sleeves in a gust and lifted the whole graduating class off the lawn. They landed in the library and stayed to study.
lore.legendary: Has worn so many professors that it now gives the lectures itself. Nobody noticed, except that the jokes got better.

names.legendary: Sir Bibbington, Hero of the Highchair

lore.common: Catches everything except the food that falls in your lap.
lore.uncommon: Ties at the back of your neck, then comes undone just before pudding.
lore.rare: Catches flying food and flings it straight back. The highchair has won every food fight since.
lore.epic: Stretched out to catch a whole party's spaghetti at once. The ceiling stayed clean, and the dog has never forgiven it.
lore.legendary: Caught every crumb a baby dropped for two whole years. The floor has never needed sweeping and the dog had to get a job.

lore.common: Comes out of the washing machine tangled round every sock in the load.
lore.uncommon: Has tiny hooks at the back that are very fiddly to do up in a hurry.
lore.rare: Hooks itself onto anything that passes the washing line. So far it has caught a kite, a pigeon and next door's cat.
lore.epic: Flapped on the washing line in a gale, and the neighbours found it in their garden.
lore.legendary: Blew off the line in a gale and flew all day like a kite with two sails. It landed folded, in the right drawer.

names.legendary: Sir Steelheart, Shield of the Knight

lore.common: Clanks so loudly when you walk that everyone knows you're coming.
lore.uncommon: Gets so hot in the sun that the knight fries his breakfast egg on it.
lore.rare: Bounced an arrow straight back at the archer who fired it.
lore.epic: Clanged so loudly when its knight fell off his horse that the drawbridge slammed shut. The knights have been stuck outside since Tuesday.
lore.legendary: Bounced a dragon's sneeze straight back up its nose. The dragon has carried a hanky ever since.

names.legendary: Sir Linksworth of the Iron Rings

lore.common: Jingles with every step, so knights can never sneak up on anyone.
lore.uncommon: Catches every crumb in its rings. A knight can eat breakfast out of it at lunchtime.
lore.rare: Stopped a sword's swipe and only lost one tiny ring.
lore.epic: Shook itself like a wet dog after the rain and soaked every knight at the feast. The king's soup is now mostly puddle.
lore.legendary: Was taken apart ring by ring by a magpie and rebuilt as a nest. The magpie now goes jousting on Saturdays.

lore.common: Clanks against the table every time its knight leans over to reach the salt.
lore.uncommon: Is curved so smoothly that the castle cats use it as a slide.
lore.rare: Made a sword slide off its curved front and into a hay bale.
lore.epic: Caught the midday sun and beamed it across the castle. The cook's pies baked themselves before anyone lit the oven.
lore.legendary: Was hit by a hundred lances in one tournament and came out with only a slightly sad dent.

names.legendary: Captain Absorbo of the Changing Mat

lore.common: Comes untaped at exactly the wrong moment, usually in the middle of the supermarket.
lore.uncommon: Crinkles so loudly when the baby crawls that everyone knows where it is.
lore.rare: Fills with so much air that the baby floats. Bath time now needs a lifeguard and a rubber duck on patrol.
lore.epic: Was changed twelve times in one day during the big family visit, and the bin gave up.
lore.legendary: Kept a baby dry on a sailing trip all the way round the world. The baby came home and asked for a boat of its own.

lore.common: Twists its straps into a knot every time you climb out of the pool.
lore.uncommon: Stretches so much that it fits on every swimmer in the family.
lore.rare: Swims faster than its swimmer and drags her down the lane. She has won races she never meant to enter.
lore.epic: Stretched across the whole pool like a lane rope. The swimmers bounced off it all afternoon and nobody finished.
lore.legendary: Swam so many lengths in one summer that the pool got shorter. The council had to repaint the lines.

names.legendary: Lord Snoozewell of the Bunk Bed

lore.common: Is buttoned up wrongly every night, so one side always hangs lower.
lore.uncommon: Has little cartoons all over it that seem to dance when you're nearly asleep.
lore.rare: Puts anyone who touches it to sleep in ten seconds. The doctor came round and is still snoring on the sofa.
lore.epic: Started a pillow fight so big that the feathers came down as snow. The school closed for a snow day.
lore.legendary: Has heard every secret whispered at a hundred sleepovers. It now runs the most-read newspaper in the street.

lore.common: Comes undone at the knot just as you stand up from your beach towel.
lore.uncommon: Can be worn as a skirt, a scarf, a picnic blanket or a sunshade.
lore.rare: Catches the breeze like a sail and drags its wearer down the beach. She got to the ice-cream van first, backwards.
lore.epic: Unfolded on the windy beach until it covered the whole shore. The crabs held a party underneath.
lore.legendary: Was tied to a mast when the sail tore and blew a fishing boat all the way home. The fish were very disappointed.

names.legendary: Big Splashworth of the Diving Board

lore.common: Its drawstring always disappears back inside the waistband.
lore.uncommon: Dries in the sun in four seconds flat, just in time to be pushed back into the pool.
lore.rare: Did a cannonball off the side of the pool so big that the lifeguard got soaked.
lore.epic: Ballooned up with air and floated the whole family across the lake. Dad steered with his feet.
lore.legendary: Jumped off the top board and did so many flips that it landed tomorrow. Its owner had to wait a day to get dressed.

names.legendary: Old Comfy, Favourite of All Time

lore.common: Its label scratches the back of your neck all day long.
lore.uncommon: Comes out of the washing basket inside out every single time.
lore.rare: Attracted every drop of ketchup at the barbecue, and never a drop on the plate.
lore.epic: Untucked itself in the school photo and every shirt in the row did the same. The picture is now mostly elbows.
lore.legendary: Was worn so often that it learned to fold itself. It now does the whole family's ironing, and complains.

names.legendary: Madame Rideau of the Royal Stage

lore.common: Gets stuck halfway open on opening night, so the audience sees only half the actors.
lore.uncommon: Opens so slowly that the actors have to stand still and wait.
lore.rare: Swept across the stage so fast that it knocked off the villain's hat.
lore.epic: Came down in the middle of the play and refused to go back up. The audience watched it for an hour and clapped.
lore.legendary: Upstaged the lead actor by closing on him mid-song. The audience loved it, and the curtain now has its own dressing room.

names.legendary: Lady Plushwell of the Drawing Room

lore.common: Feels lovely one way and horrible the other, so everyone strokes it in the right direction.
lore.uncommon: Shows every thumbprint you make, so it looks like someone has been writing on it.
lore.rare: Grabbed every cat hair in the house and refused to let any of them go.
lore.epic: Covered every cushion in the grand house, and the guests sank in up to their elbows.
lore.legendary: Was so soft that a whole castle fell asleep on it for a hundred years. The dragon outside gave up and opened a café.

lore.common: Has so much gold thread that it sets off the metal detector at every door.
lore.uncommon: Is embroidered with so much gold thread that it glitters under every lamp.
lore.rare: Is so stiff with embroidery that it stands up on its own. It has been mistaken for its wearer twice.
lore.epic: Swept down the town hall steps with a train so long that it reached the bus stop. Two buses waited to let it pass.
lore.legendary: Shone with so much gold that a dragon tried to sleep on it. The dragon now has a very sparkly back and a sore neck.

lore.common: Tangles itself into a giant knot every time the kitten is in the room.
lore.uncommon: Keeps unrolling across the floor to see where it ends. It always ends under the fridge.
lore.rare: Knits itself into a jumper overnight, always with one arm too long. The cat wears the spare.
lore.epic: Rolled out of the knitting basket and wound itself round every chair leg in the house.
lore.legendary: Was rolled out so far by the kitten that it reached the next country. The kitten came home a year later with a passport.

names.legendary: Lady Glovington of the Hat Stand

lore.common: Loses one of itself on every bus ride, so there's always one lonely glove left.
lore.uncommon: Never has your fingers in the right holes the first time.
lore.rare: Points at whatever its owner is secretly thinking about. It pointed at the cake all through the wedding speeches.
lore.epic: Made a hundred snowballs in one afternoon, and the snowman was very nervous.
lore.legendary: Stayed together as a pair for twenty years. Every lost glove in town now writes to it for advice.

lore.common: Has only a thumb hole, so you can't pick up anything smaller than a snowball.
lore.uncommon: Is tied together with a string through your coat sleeves so it can never get lost.
lore.rare: Got so caked with snow that it turned into two little snowmen.
lore.epic: Got so warm in the snow fight that the whole street melted. The snowmen are now puddles with carrot noses.
lore.legendary: Held hands with a snowman all winter so it would not feel lonely. In spring the snowman left it a carrot.

names.legendary: Sir Sockington, Star of the Show

lore.common: Always comes out of the washing machine with only one of itself.
lore.uncommon: Gets a hole in the big toe just when you're about to take your shoes off at a friend's house.
lore.rare: Smelled so bad after football that the dog ran out of the room.
lore.epic: Slid down the stairs like a sledge and kept going out of the front door. It was found three streets away, still sliding.
lore.legendary: Was worn as a puppet and gave such a speech that the audience cried. It now has an agent and an understudy sock.

names.legendary: Lady Bowella of the Gift Wrap

lore.common: Comes undone at the worst moment and trails behind like a tail.
lore.uncommon: Gets pulled into a tighter knot every time someone tries to untie it.
lore.rare: Ties itself onto anything that stays still for a minute. Grandpa woke up from his nap gift-wrapped.
lore.epic: Tied the whole birthday party into one enormous present. Nobody got out until the birthday girl pulled one end.
lore.legendary: Tied itself round the whole town on a birthday morning. The mayor had to unwrap the high street before the shops could open.

lore.common: Dips itself into your soup every time you lean forward.
lore.uncommon: Is tied too tight in the morning and pulled loose by lunch.
lore.rare: Flapped over its owner's shoulder in the wind and slapped him on the ear.
lore.epic: Was knotted so tight that the whole office held its breath. The meeting finished in two minutes and everyone went home early.
lore.legendary: Was tied in a knot so clever that nobody could undo it for forty years. Grandad now sleeps in it and calls it a scarf.

lore.common: Pinches your ankle every time you zip it up.
lore.uncommon: Hops over puddles on tiptoes so its suede doesn't get wet.
lore.rare: Clicked its heels so loudly in the hallway that the dog thought someone was knocking.
lore.epic: Clicked down the high street so steadily that every clock in town set itself by it. The town now wakes when it walks.
lore.legendary: Strutted through the city so stylishly that the statues turned to look. One of them has not turned back since.

names.legendary: The Badge That Promoted a Goat

lore.common: Pricks your finger every time you pin it on.
lore.uncommon: Is collected by the hundred and pinned to every inch of a school bag.
lore.rare: Turns its wearer into whatever job it says. A boy wore HEAD CHEF and now cooks all the school dinners.
lore.epic: Started a badge swap at the fair, and every jacket in town came home covered.
lore.legendary: Was pinned on a goat by mistake, and the goat was made head teacher. Exam results are up and the lawn is very short.

lore.common: Slips off your heel every time you run for the bus.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it walk on tiptoe as if they're on a stage.
lore.rare: Spins its wearer whenever music plays. Grandma got stuck at the supermarket till for a whole song.
lore.epic: Spun so fast on stage that it drilled straight through the floor. The rest of the ballet happened in the basement.
lore.legendary: Danced so lightly that it crossed the lake without touching the water. The swans have asked for lessons.

lore.common: Its belt trails on the floor and gets caught under the door.
lore.uncommon: Is so fluffy and warm that you never want to take it off.
lore.rare: Answered the door to the postman so confidently that he thought it was a business suit.
lore.epic: Puffed up so fluffy that it filled the whole hallway. The family has climbed over it to reach the kitchen all week.
lore.legendary: Has spent so many lazy mornings in the kitchen that it makes breakfast by itself. The toast is always a little fluffy.

lore.common: Is always one notch too tight after a big dinner.
lore.uncommon: Clanks its buckle on the chair every time you sit down.
lore.rare: Snaps like a whip whenever someone reaches for the last chip. Nobody in the house has had a last chip in years.
lore.epic: Slid off and lay in the garden pretending to be a snake. The whole street is still waiting at the window for the zoo.
lore.legendary: Wrapped round the leaning tower one night and pulled it straight. The tower is now perfectly upright and a bit embarrassed.

lore.common: Twists its straps into a knot every time it goes into the beach bag.
lore.uncommon: Leaves funny white tan lines after a day in the sun.
lore.rare: Builds a sandcastle on the towel whenever nobody is looking. The seagulls have started queuing to visit.
lore.epic: Spiked a beach ball so hard that it bounced off the lighthouse. The boats now steer by the ball.
lore.legendary: Built a sandcastle so big at low tide that the sea could not get round it. The tide went home sulking.

lore.common: Squeaks on every step down the quiet library corridor.
lore.uncommon: Has little holes punched in patterns all over it, which collect every speck of dust.
lore.rare: Taps out messages through its little holes as it walks. It told the whole office who ate the last doughnut.
lore.epic: Clattered so loudly that every desk in the office clattered back. Nothing got done and the boss called it teamwork.
lore.legendary: Walked into the wrong office every day for a year and nobody noticed. It is now the manager.

lore.common: Catches in every door on the way out of the house.
lore.uncommon: Flaps dramatically behind you whenever you run, even indoors.
lore.rare: Made its wearer feel so heroic that he rescued a cat from a very low branch.
lore.epic: Flew its wearer off the shed and over every fence in the street, then got bored. He walked home from the next village.
lore.legendary: Flew its wearer to the Moon and back before tea. He was still told off for not finishing his peas.

lore.common: Gets its sleeve caught on every door handle, then unravels a little bit more each time.
lore.uncommon: Has leather patches on its elbows that make everyone look like a professor.
lore.rare: Unravels at night and knits a tiny copy of itself. There are now nine cardigans and one confused granny.
lore.epic: Unravelled at the family party until the living room was one big woolly web. Grandad is still stuck in the armchair.
lore.legendary: Has been buttoned wrong for fifty years, so now the whole family buttons everything one hole down. Even the shop has started.

names.legendary: Lord Chelsington of the High Street

lore.common: Needs its little tab pulled so hard that you fall over backwards putting it on.
lore.uncommon: Stretches to fit anyone, so the whole family keeps borrowing it. It has not been home since Tuesday.
lore.rare: Snaps its elastic at anyone who steps on its toes. Nobody stands near it in the lift.
lore.epic: Strutted through a puddle so big that the high street flooded behind it. The shops sold umbrellas until midnight.
lore.legendary: Slipped off so easily that it went to a party without its owner. It came home at dawn with laces it did not need.

names.legendary: Golden Studs, Scorer of the Final

lore.common: Clacks on the kitchen tiles like a tap dancer, and the dog joins in.
lore.uncommon: Clacks so loudly on the changing room floor that the whole team marches.
lore.rare: Digs in so hard that it plants its owner like a tree. The coach had to lift him off the pitch with a spade.
lore.epic: Ran down the pitch so fast that it ploughed a row in the turf. The groundskeeper planted potatoes in it.
lore.legendary: Kicked a ball so high that it came down at the first match of next season. The referee counted it.

names.legendary: Lady Crimpwell of the Rock Face

lore.common: Squeezes your toes so tightly that you hobble back to the car.
lore.uncommon: Is always covered in chalk dust that gets all over the car seats.
lore.rare: Climbs anything it sees, with or without you. It has been found on the fridge, the bookcase and the cat.
lore.epic: Climbed the outside of a block of flats to fetch a lost balloon. Every floor handed it a cup of tea on the way up.
lore.legendary: Climbed the tallest cliff in the country upside down. At the top it found a sign: LIFT OUT OF ORDER.

lore.common: Drags its hem through every puddle, so it comes home heavier than it left.
lore.uncommon: Swirls round its wearer in the wind like a little storm.
lore.rare: Makes its wearer invisible, but only to their little brother. He has been looking for her since spring.
lore.epic: Swirled so hard in the forest that every leaf blew off the trees. Autumn arrived two weeks early.
lore.legendary: Pulled its hood up so fast that it hid a whole mountain from a storm. The storm walked past and soaked the next valley.

names.legendary: Old Klompen of the Tulip Fields

lore.common: Clomps so loudly on the stairs that the whole house wakes up.
lore.uncommon: Floats in every puddle like a little boat, and the ducks keep climbing in.
lore.rare: Kicks off so hard that it flies into next door's garden. The neighbours now return it with a cake each time.
lore.epic: Clomped so loudly on the cobbles that every tulip in the field opened up. The bees have never worked so hard.
lore.legendary: Clomped so hard in one dance that it rang the town bell from the square. Everyone came for lunch at ten in the morning.

lore.common: Gets its zip stuck at the back so you need two friends to get out of it.
lore.uncommon: Has a long stuffed tail that knocks the drinks off every table at the party.
lore.rare: Made its wearer act exactly like a pirate for a whole afternoon, and nobody could stop them.
lore.epic: Turned up at the fancy dress party with fifty copies of itself, and nobody knew who was who.
lore.legendary: Turned its wearer into such a good dragon that the fire brigade came round. They stayed for cake.

lore.common: Squeaks on the kitchen floor with every single step.
lore.uncommon: Has so many holes that your socks poke out in little bumps.
lore.rare: Collected every pebble on the path inside its holes, and rattled all the way home.
lore.epic: Squeaked so loudly in the garden that every slug packed up and left. Next door's lettuces are now very crowded.
lore.legendary: Floated down the river after a flood and became a boat for a family of frogs. They now run river tours on Sundays.

names.legendary: Lady Midriff of the Dance Floor

lore.common: Rides up every time you raise your arms to wave.
lore.uncommon: Makes its wearer clap along to every song, even the fire alarm.
lore.rare: Glows in the dark so brightly that the school disco has turned off its lights for good.
lore.epic: Danced so hard at the summer fair that the bouncy castle joined in. It bounced off down the road, still full of children.
lore.legendary: Danced every night for a whole summer and taught the Moon to do the twist. The tides have been wobbly ever since.

names.legendary: Sir Derbyshire of the School Corridor

lore.common: Its laces come undone halfway to school every single morning.
lore.uncommon: Gets checked for shine by the headteacher every Monday.
lore.rare: Squeaks the answer to every test question, but always one question late.
lore.epic: Marched into assembly so loudly that the head teacher forgot his speech. The school sang the dinner menu instead.
lore.legendary: Walked to school so many years in a row that it now goes on its own, and the teacher marks it present.

lore.common: Its strap slips off your shoulder every time you bend down.
lore.uncommon: Has a pocket on the front for a pencil, a ruler and a snail.
lore.rare: Got so splattered with paint in art class that it became a work of art itself.
lore.epic: Dug up the whole allotment looking for one lost carrot. It found forty potatoes, a gnome, and the carrot in its own pocket.
lore.legendary: Has so many pockets that a whole vegetable patch grew in them. Tomatoes come up through the bib every August.

lore.common: Gets its rope sole soaked in the first puddle and squelches for the rest of the day.
lore.uncommon: Slips on and off so easily that it keeps slipping off on the beach steps.
lore.rare: Unravels its rope sole to lasso anything it wants. So far it has caught a hat, a kite and a runaway beach ball.
lore.epic: Unwound its rope sole so far that it tied every boat in the harbour together. The fishing fleet went out as one big raft.
lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a rope and used to tie up a ship all summer. The ship is still there, and so is the shoe.

names.legendary: Old Polarfluff of the Mountain Hut

lore.common: Grows little fluff balls all over it after one wash.
lore.uncommon: Gives you a small static shock every time you take it off.
lore.rare: Collects every leaf, twig and burr on a walk and brings them indoors. Its owner came home wearing half a hedge.
lore.epic: Built up so much static on the school trip that every child's hair stood on end. The class photo looks like a field of dandelions.
lore.legendary: Sparked so much static on a mountain that it lit the hut lamps for a whole winter. The hikers rub it before dinner.

lore.common: Slaps against your heel with every step, so everyone hears you coming.
lore.uncommon: Has a little post between your toes that rubs a bit after an hour.
lore.rare: Slaps out a rhythm so catchy that strangers follow it down the beach. It once led a conga line into the sea.
lore.epic: Flew off a foot at the top of the water slide and went down alone. It finished first and refused to get out of the pool.
lore.legendary: Lost its partner in the sea and swam after it across the whole ocean. They met on a beach in another country and stayed for the summer.

lore.common: Kicks a ball against the garage door every evening until the whole street knows the score.
lore.uncommon: Brings half the football pitch home in its studs.
lore.rare: Curled a free kick round the wall and into the top corner.
lore.epic: Kicked the ball so hard that it went round the world and hit the goalkeeper from behind. The goal still counts.
lore.legendary: Scored a thousand goals in one long career, all from the bench. Nobody has worked out how.

lore.common: Wobbles on every step so you hold onto the wall.
lore.uncommon: Gets its heel stuck between every cobblestone in the old town.
lore.rare: Makes its wearer taller every hour of the party. By midnight she was looking down on the chandelier.
lore.epic: Clacked across the town square so loudly that every pigeon took off at once. The statue was clean for the first time in years.
lore.legendary: Made its wearer so tall at the harbour ball that ships took her for the lighthouse. Two of them steered over to say hello.

lore.common: Gives you a blister on the first day of every new hike.
lore.uncommon: Has a sole so grippy that it climbs muddy hills without slipping.
lore.rare: Always knows the way home, but only the long way. Its owner has now seen every hill in the county twice.
lore.epic: Stomped up the same hill so often that it wore the top flat. The hill is now a very popular picnic table.
lore.legendary: Climbed every peak in the country, then the shed roof, because it was there. Grandad still cannot get it down.

names.legendary: Lady Glissade of the Ice Rink

lore.common: Makes your ankles wobble on the ice like a newborn deer.
lore.uncommon: Has a blade so sharp that it leaves little white lines across the ice.
lore.rare: Carved a perfect figure of eight into the ice so deep that the ice-smoothing machine had to go round it twice.
lore.epic: Spun so fast on the frozen pond that it drilled a hole and a fish popped out. The fish now takes skating lessons.
lore.legendary: Skated across a lake so fast that the water froze just in front of it. It reached the far side in July.

lore.common: Has to be taken off completely every time you need the toilet.
lore.uncommon: Zips up from toes to chin so fast that it once zipped the cat in too.
lore.rare: Zips up anyone who stands still for too long. The dog, the cat and the hoover now wear matching suits.
lore.epic: Zipped up so fast in the hangar that it shot its wearer into the sky. He landed on the runway like a very small plane.
lore.legendary: Flew a plane across the ocean when the pilot nodded off. It landed perfectly and asked for more peanuts.

lore.common: Catches every thistle on the hill and brings it indoors to sit on.
lore.uncommon: Has a tartan pattern that tells everyone which family you belong to.
lore.rare: Plays a little bagpipe tune whenever it swishes. The whole village knows when its owner sneaks to the fridge.
lore.epic: Danced a Highland fling so fast that it spun up a whirlwind. The bagpipes are still stuck up a tree in the next glen.
lore.legendary: Tossed a tree trunk so far that it landed on a castle and became its flagpole. The laird is delighted and slightly worried.

lore.common: Takes ten minutes to zip up and another ten to zip down.
lore.uncommon: Hugs its wearer's legs so tightly that she waddles like a penguin.
lore.rare: Grows a little taller every time someone says it is too tall. It now reaches its owner's chin.
lore.epic: Kicked through the autumn leaves so hard that they filled the sky. The trees put them back on wrong.
lore.legendary: Strode across a river without wetting its owner, then a lake, then the sea. She went shopping in France.

lore.common: Swings round and slaps you on the chin every time you run for the lift.
lore.uncommon: Beeps you through every door in the office building.
lore.rare: Swung its keys round in a circle so fast that it unlocked the wrong car.
lore.epic: Opened every door in the building at once. The office cat now has its own desk and a parking space.
lore.legendary: Opened a door in the office that nobody knew was there. Behind it were all the pens anyone had ever lost.

lore.common: Goes baggy at the knees after one day of wear.
lore.uncommon: Stretches so far that you can do a full squat without a wobble.
lore.rare: Stretches so far that its owner can reach the remote from the sofa, and next door's remote too.
lore.epic: Stretched between two trees like a giant slingshot and launched a whole yoga class over the pond. They landed in perfect poses.
lore.legendary: Stretched from one bank of the river to the other and became a bridge. The ducks use it every morning.

lore.common: Has eye holes that never line up with your actual eyes.
lore.uncommon: Hides your face so well that your own dog barks at you.
lore.rare: Swaps faces with whoever looks at it. The head teacher spent a whole assembly as a tiger.
lore.epic: Made everyone at the masked ball forget who they were. They all went home to the wrong houses and nobody complained.
lore.legendary: Slipped into the grand ball without a ticket and danced all night with the mayor. He still has not noticed it was on a mop.

lore.common: Is so soft that you feel every pebble on the path.
lore.uncommon: Has beads stitched on top that the magpies keep trying to steal, one at a time, while it walks.
lore.rare: Walked through the forest so silently that the deer didn't look up.
lore.epic: Crept through the forest so quietly that the trees forgot it was there and fell asleep. Spring came a week late.
lore.legendary: Has walked so softly for so long that it leaves no footprints at all. The snails have been trying to follow it for years.

lore.common: Flaps off your heel every few steps because it has no back.
lore.uncommon: Slides across the polished floor like it's on ice.
lore.rare: Kicks itself off under café tables and wanders. It has been found in the kitchen, the cellar and behind the till.
lore.epic: Clacked across the terrace so loudly that the café chairs started dancing. Lunch was served on the move.
lore.legendary: Was kicked off under a café table in Paris and walked home across the whole country. It arrived for breakfast, wanting croissants.

lore.common: Is so long that you trip on its hem going down the stairs.
lore.uncommon: Glides along the landing at night like a little ghost.
lore.rare: Glows softly at midnight, so nobody in the house needs a night light. The moths have started visiting.
lore.epic: Sleepwalked its wearer to the bus stop at midnight. She caught the first bus and got to work early, in her nightgown.
lore.legendary: Floated off the landing one windy night and drifted over the town like a cloud. It rained gently on every allotment.

lore.common: Has little ears on its hood that flop into your eyes.
lore.uncommon: Has a zip at the back that you can't reach on your own.
lore.rare: Made its wearer feel so much like a bear that they growled at breakfast.
lore.epic: Made a whole sleepover feel so much like bears that they hibernated. They woke up in April asking for honey.
lore.legendary: Was so cosy that a real bear borrowed it for the winter. It came back washed, folded and smelling of honey.

names.legendary: Old Farmer Overall of the Barn

lore.common: Its metal clips clatter against the table every time you sit down.
lore.uncommon: Has a pocket for every tool in the shed.
lore.rare: Bounces mud straight back at whoever splashed it. The pigs have stopped trying.
lore.epic: Pitched so much hay at the barn dance that the barn filled to the roof. The band kept playing from inside a haystack.
lore.legendary: Worked the farm so long that the cows now follow it, not the farmer. He has to wear it to get the milk.

names.legendary: Sir Oxford of the Grand Hall

lore.common: Needs polishing every morning or it sulks.
lore.uncommon: Has laces that tie so neatly that it looks like a present.
lore.rare: Walked into a job interview so confidently that its owner got the job.
lore.epic: Strode across the stage at graduation so confidently that it was handed everyone's certificates. It is now the most qualified shoe in town.
lore.legendary: Was so smart that it was invited to the grand dinner without its owner. It sat at the top table and used the right fork.

lore.common: Never has the top and bottoms from the same set.
lore.uncommon: Its elastic waistband slips down every time you run up the stairs.
lore.rare: Makes every day a pyjama day for the whole house. The plumber came to fix the sink and stayed for cartoons.
lore.epic: Was so comfy that the whole town stayed home in pyjamas on Monday. The mayor gave the news from bed.
lore.legendary: Is so soft that clouds float down to touch it. The garden is foggy every morning and very comfy.

lore.common: Its fluffy hood tickles your face all day.
lore.uncommon: Has a hood so deep that you can only see out through a tiny tunnel of fur.
lore.rare: Pulls its hood shut whenever someone says something boring. Maths lessons are now very quiet.
lore.epic: Was so warm on the snowy school trip that a whole fox family moved in. The class came home with five extra pupils.
lore.legendary: Kept its owner so warm at the North Pole that the ice melted round him. He now has a private swimming pool.

names.legendary: Madame Platforma of the Lamp Posts

lore.common: Makes you so tall that you bump your head on the door frame.
lore.uncommon: Has a sole so thick that you can't feel the ground at all.
lore.rare: Danced at the disco so well that the floor lit up under it.
lore.epic: Stomped so hard at the disco that the glitter ball fell and rolled down the high street. The town danced after it until dawn.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall that its wearer now changes the street-lamp bulbs by hand. The council has offered her a job.

lore.common: Gets stuck on your head every time you try to put it on.
lore.uncommon: Sheds the rain all round you like a little tent.
lore.rare: Turns into a tent at the first drop of rain, whether its wearer is ready or not. He spent a whole bus ride camping.
lore.epic: Caught a gust on the mountain and glided its wearer down to the village like a paraglider. He arrived in time for lunch.
lore.legendary: Spread out so wide in a storm that it kept a whole herd of llamas dry. The llamas now refuse to go out without it.

names.legendary: Captain Puffington of the Ski Lodge

lore.common: Makes your arms stick out so you can't put your hands in your pockets.
lore.uncommon: Is so puffy and warm that it feels like wearing a duvet.
lore.rare: Squashes into a tiny bag, then puffs back to full size wherever it likes. It burst a lunchbox open on the school bus.
lore.epic: Puffed up so much on the ski lift that it wedged itself between two chairs. Everyone had lunch dangling in the air.
lore.legendary: Puffed up so big on a cold night that it floated off like a hot-air balloon. Its owner enjoyed the view and landed for breakfast.

names.legendary: Lady Pumpington of the Dance Hall

lore.common: Pinches your little toe after the first dance, then refuses to come off when your feet swell.
lore.uncommon: Taps its heels whenever it hears a waltz, even on the bus, even at the dentist.
lore.rare: Drags its wearer into a dance with whoever is nearest. She has waltzed with a waiter, a doorman and a hat stand.
lore.epic: Spun so fast in the ballroom that the chandelier spun with it. The guests danced in circles until breakfast.
lore.legendary: Danced through the whole night of the ball and kept going for a week. The band took turns to sleep.

names.legendary: Captain Drizzle of the Bus Stop

lore.common: Blows its hood back off your head the moment the rain starts.
lore.uncommon: Rustles so loudly with every step that you can't sneak anywhere.
lore.rare: Stood under a waterfall at the park and came out with a perfectly dry jumper underneath.
lore.epic: Splashed through the flooded high street so boldly that the ducks followed it to the bus stop.
lore.legendary: Stretched over the whole bus stop in a storm and kept the queue dry. The driver refused to leave without it.

lore.common: Curls itself into a tangle in the drawer, so it never comes out straight.
lore.uncommon: Trails from every ponytail like a little swishing tail.
lore.rare: Flutters so prettily that sparrows follow it home. Eleven of them now live in the hair-tie drawer.
lore.epic: Twisted round the maypole with fifty other ribbons until the dancers were tied up too.
lore.legendary: Lassoed a runaway hot-air balloon at the village fair with one loop. The balloon now goes for walks on a lead, like a dog.

lore.common: Hangs on the back of the door at night and looks exactly like a sleepy uncle.
lore.uncommon: Always has one cold teabag in its pocket, and it turns up again after every wash.
lore.rare: Came home from the hotel in a suitcase, which nobody has ever explained.
lore.epic: Got so fluffy in the hotel tumble dryer that it filled the laundry room. The staff dug their way out with coat hangers.
lore.legendary: Was so comfortable that its owner wore it to his own wedding. The bride wore one too, and they matched.

lore.common: Hides a wheel in its heel and sends you sliding when you only wanted to walk.
lore.uncommon: Glides down the school corridor so fast that the teacher shouts slow down.
lore.rare: Rolls off downhill whenever its wearer stops to tie a lace. She has reached the bottom of every hill in town by accident.
lore.epic: Swerved through the shopping centre so fast that every escalator started running backwards. Shoppers ended up where they began.
lore.legendary: Rolled through the airport so fast that it got to the next country before its plane. It was waiting at arrivals with a sign.

lore.common: Squelches with every step when its straps get wet.
lore.uncommon: Is worn with socks by every grandad on holiday, to everyone's horror.
lore.rare: Leaves a sandal-shaped tan that lasts all year. Its owner looks as if he wears them in the bath.
lore.epic: Squelched so loudly along the seafront that the seagulls stopped stealing chips to listen. The chip shop had its best day ever.
lore.legendary: Walked the seafront for so many summers that the sand now follows it home. The front garden has become a beach.

lore.common: Takes half an hour of folding and pinning before it's ready to go.
lore.uncommon: Lets its long end flutter behind like a flag, and every small child in the room tries to catch it.
lore.rare: Has a border that changes colour with its wearer's mood. Everyone at dinner knew Auntie wanted more pudding.
lore.epic: Swirled so wide at the wedding dance that it swept every guest onto the floor. Even the cake ended up dancing.
lore.legendary: Was so long that it became a sail and carried a whole wedding party across the river. For once, everyone arrived on time.

names.legendary: Old Hornsworth of the Hall Stand

lore.common: Disappears from the hall just when you're late and your shoe won't go on.
lore.uncommon: Has such a long handle that everyone uses it to switch off the light from bed.
lore.rare: Was used as a back scratcher so often that it forgot about shoes.
lore.epic: Slid a foot into a boot so fast that the boot shot across the shop and out of the window. Sales doubled.
lore.legendary: Helped a giant into a shoe the size of a boat. The giant was so pleased that he moved his family into it.

names.legendary: Sir Cedarwood of the Shoe Rack

lore.common: Gets left inside your shoe so you put your foot in and jump.
lore.uncommon: Makes the whole wardrobe smell of cedar wood.
lore.rare: Stretches any shoe it sits in. Dad's old trainers are now big enough for the dog to sleep in.
lore.epic: Sprouted leaves in the wardrobe and grew into a real tree. The shoes now hang from its branches like fruit.
lore.legendary: Kept a pair of boots in such perfect shape that they got bored and walked off on their own. They still send postcards.

lore.common: Comes undone on every walk and trips you up on the stairs.
lore.uncommon: Gets tied in a double knot that nobody can undo.
lore.rare: Lost its little plastic end and now refuses to go through any hole.
lore.epic: Tied the laces of the whole lunch queue together. The school walked to lunch like one long caterpillar.
lore.legendary: Tied a knot so perfect that sailors come from far away to look at it. Nobody dares untie it, so the shoe has not moved in years.

lore.common: Makes you walk like a robot every time you leave the slopes.
lore.uncommon: Has buckles so tight that your feet go numb.
lore.rare: Clamps on so tight that its wearer cannot take it off until spring. He went to school in it all term.
lore.epic: Clomped across the lodge so heavily that all the snow slid off the roof at once. The lodge vanished until teatime.
lore.legendary: Skied straight off the top of the mountain and landed in the valley pool. It now does ski jumps for the swimmers.

lore.common: Slips off under the sofa every evening and hides until morning.
lore.uncommon: Gets carried off by the dog every single day.
lore.rare: Steers its owner's feet wherever it fancies. Grandad set off for the kitchen and arrived in the garden shed.
lore.epic: Shuffled across the carpet so fast that it made enough static to light the whole house. The electricity bill has never been lower.
lore.legendary: Kept grandad's feet so warm that he walked to the shop through the snow in it. The snow melted in a path behind him.

names.legendary: Old Furtop of the Frozen North

lore.common: Lets snow in at the top so your socks get soaked.
lore.uncommon: Has fleece inside so warm that your feet sweat.
lore.rare: Leaves footprints so big that people think a yeti has visited. The town now holds a yeti festival every winter.
lore.epic: Stamped off the snow so hard at the school door that it set off an avalanche in the playground. Everyone got the day off to dig.
lore.legendary: Walked all the way to the North Pole to post one letter. The letter got there first.

names.legendary: Lightning Lane, Fastest on the Track

lore.common: Leaves little holes in the grass all the way to the car.
lore.uncommon: Grips the running track so well that you take off like a rocket.
lore.rare: Leapt out of the starting blocks so fast that the starter's pistol was still echoing.
lore.epic: Ran round the track so fast that it lapped itself and tripped over its own footprints. Sports day had to start again.
lore.legendary: Ran the hundred metres so fast that it finished before the race was announced. It is still waiting for the others.

lore.common: Sinks into the lawn at every garden party.
lore.uncommon: Clicks and clacks on the marble floor so loudly that everyone turns round.
lore.rare: Pins down anything that tries to blow away. The picnic has never been safer, but the kite has not flown in years.
lore.epic: Strutted down the runway so sharply that it popped every balloon at the show. The photographers thought it was fireworks.
lore.legendary: Walked a tightrope across the town square on one heel. The circus has asked it to stop showing off.

lore.common: Gets a ladder up the leg the first time you put it on.
lore.uncommon: Slides down your legs all day so you keep tugging it back up.
lore.rare: Snaps back like a catapult when it is pulled. It fired a pea right across the dinner table.
lore.epic: Stretched across the whole garden and became a washing line. The neighbours have started pegging their socks on it.
lore.legendary: Ran so many ladders in one night that a family of mice used them to climb the pantry shelf. They now live behind the jam.

names.legendary: Sir Braceworth of the Big Top

lore.common: Pings off your trousers when you bend over and hits you on the chin.
lore.uncommon: Holds up trousers that are much too big for you.
lore.rare: Hoisted its owner's trousers so high that his socks showed.
lore.epic: Pinged its owner so high at the barn dance that he landed in the hayloft. He watched the rest of the dance from up there.
lore.legendary: Pinged a clown clean over the big top. He landed in the ringmaster's chair, and the circus has been his ever since.

names.legendary: Big Splash Barry of the Lake

lore.common: Leaves a wet patch on every seat you sit on after a swim.
lore.uncommon: Has the loudest pattern on the beach, and everyone knows who you are.
lore.rare: Floats its wearer like a duck, so he can never dive under. The other swimmers use him as a buoy.
lore.epic: Jumped into the lake so hard that all the water jumped out. The fish waited on the bank while it filled back up.
lore.legendary: Swam across the lake so fast that its wearer came out dry on the other side. The towel feels very unwanted.

lore.common: Its straps snap against your shoulder when you pull them.
lore.uncommon: Fades a little more after every swim in the chlorine pool.
lore.rare: Changes colour to match the pool, so nobody can find its wearer at home time.
lore.epic: Splashed in so hard that the deep end swapped places with the shallow end. Nobody could touch the bottom anywhere.
lore.legendary: Swam up the river and back before breakfast, and the river had to sit down. It now only flows in the afternoons.

lore.common: Has armholes so big that it slides around all day.
lore.uncommon: Has no sleeves, so your shoulders get sunburnt.
lore.rare: Let its wearer flex their arms at the beach so proudly that the lifeguard flexed back.
lore.epic: Flapped its armholes so hard in the heatwave that it cooled the whole beach. The seagulls put on scarves.
lore.legendary: Showed off its owner's arms so proudly that a mountain flexed back. Climbers say the bump on top is new.

lore.common: Twists round as you walk, so the seam ends up running down your shin.
lore.uncommon: Crackles with so much static that every balloon at the party sticks to its wearer.
lore.rare: Stretches into a skipping rope for anyone who asks. The whole playground has a turn before lunch.
lore.epic: Stretched across the stage as a tightrope in the school play. The cast walked it, and the wizard fell into the orchestra.
lore.legendary: Was pulled on by an octopus at the aquarium, all eight legs at once. The octopus now refuses to go out without them.

lore.common: Comes untied at the belt so it flaps like a little tent.
lore.uncommon: Has to be tucked into everything, and is always half out.
lore.rare: Turned its wearer into a knight so convincing that the castle guide asked for directions.
lore.epic: Made a whole class believe they were knights. They stormed the school kitchen and captured the custard.
lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a real knight's tunic and put in the castle museum. It now gives the tours and tells all the jokes.

names.legendary: Professor Rollneck of the Old Library

lore.common: Swallows your chin whenever you look down.
lore.uncommon: Itches your neck all day long.
lore.rare: Kept its wearer's neck so warm that they took off their scarf in a snowstorm.
lore.epic: Pulled itself over its wearer's head in the middle of a lecture. The hall laughed so hard that the professor did the same.
lore.legendary: Swallowed its wearer's head so completely that he spent the winter inside. He read twelve books and came out a genius.

names.legendary: Old Pantaloon of the Washing Line

lore.common: Its elastic snaps when you're running for the bus.
lore.uncommon: Is always found on the bathroom floor, never in the laundry basket.
lore.rare: Turns the colour of whatever it is washed with. It has been every colour of the rainbow since Tuesday.
lore.epic: Blew off the washing line and landed on the head of the town statue. The council says it is now part of the statue.
lore.legendary: Stretched its elastic so far that it became the finish tape at the town race. The winner snapped it and it flew all the way home.

lore.common: Always has its tie crooked by the end of the school day.
lore.uncommon: Has a badge on the pocket that it shows off to everyone.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who wears it stand up straight and salute. Grandad saluted the fridge for a whole hour.
lore.epic: Ironed itself so stiffly that it marched to school without its owner. It got a gold star for good behaviour.
lore.legendary: Polished its buttons so brightly that the whole parade marched into its own reflection. The band is still saluting itself.

lore.common: Is always worn under your shirt, even in the summer.
lore.uncommon: Is so warm that its wearer refuses to take off his coat, his scarf or the vest, even in July.
lore.rare: Holds in so much heat that its wearer can melt the frost off the car with a hug.
lore.epic: Was so warm in the coldest week that the whole family lived in it together. Dad's head came out of the left armhole.
lore.legendary: Kept its wearer so warm at the South Pole that the penguins queued to stand next to him.

names.legendary: Madame Corkwell of the Garden Party

lore.common: Leaves a trail of cork crumbs everywhere, so you can always find your way back to it.
lore.uncommon: Has a cork sole so light that it feels like walking on air.
lore.rare: Floats like a cork, so its wearer bobs straight back up whenever she tries to dive. She has tried eleven times.
lore.epic: Danced on the wooden deck at the summer wedding until every board squeaked along in tune.
lore.legendary: Bobbed out to sea after a garden party and came back a week later with a seagull captain. The seagull now comes to every party.

names.legendary: Captain Neoprene of the Big Wave

lore.common: Takes twenty minutes to peel off after a swim, inside out.
lore.uncommon: Pinches every hair on your arm as you put it on.
lore.rare: Is so slippery that it slides its wearer straight off every surfboard. The seals laugh every single time.
lore.epic: Squeaked so loudly going on that every dolphin in the bay came to look. Surf school became dolphin watching.
lore.legendary: Rode a wave so big that it surfed into next week. It came home sunburnt, with a postcard from Thursday.

names.legendary: Lord Gustwell of the Cliff Path

lore.common: Flaps so loudly in the wind that you can't hear anyone talk.
lore.uncommon: Fills up with wind like a balloon and makes its wearer walk on tiptoe.
lore.rare: Blocked the wind on the clifftop so well that its wearer could eat a sandwich in a gale.
lore.epic: Caught a gust on the beach and lifted its wearer like a kite. He waved to the gulls and landed on the pier for lunch.
lore.legendary: Stood in the way of a gale on the cliff top. The wind said sorry and went the long way round.
